Download the installer for your platform below.

**macOS:** download the signed + notarized universal `ChatOSS_<version>_universal.dmg` — one build that runs natively on both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs — built and uploaded from a developer machine with the Apple Developer ID certificate.
**Windows:** ChatOSS_*_x64-setup.exe
**Linux:** ChatOSS_*_amd64.AppImage or .deb


## What is new in v1.31.5

- **Signing in works again — and it stays signed in.** Supabase disabled this app's old public "anon" API key on 2026-11-17 (one-way, it cannot be re-enabled). Every installed copy authenticated with it, so sign-in, sign-up and browser (PKCE) sign-in failed with `401 Legacy API keys are disabled`, and anyone already signed in was dropped back to the login screen at the 1-hour token boundary when the automatic refresh was rejected. v1.31.5 ships the project's new publishable client key, so sign-in, sign-up, PKCE sign-in and the hourly token refresh all work again. If you were bounced to login, update and sign in once — the session then survives restarts.
